title: Actual stopped RGO depth and finite-cap stability
source_anchor: arXiv:2609.06906v1 Algorithm3.3 fixed terminal threshold and Theorem6.5 equation(6.4)
target_statement: Fix an initial explicit state s0 and positive-dimensional finite real Hilbert Borel space E. Let kappa>=1,0<c<1/4,q>=2,0<Delta<=1/2,0<gamma<=1,C>=8. For measurable eta on the full history state with 0<eta(s)<=c, use the source normalized variance a(s)=(eta(s)+tau(b(s)))/(1+b(s)), where K(b)=(1+b)/(kappa^-1+b) and tau is K when K>=2 and c otherwise. Compute L=q+log(K(b0)*finrank(E)*q/Delta), Aterminal=gamma/(sqrt(finrank(E)*L)+L), Bterminal=1/Aterminal and J=ceil(C log(e K(b0)/Aterminal)) from s0 once. Instantiate FiniteRGOProgram with this fixed threshold and actual supplied Markov observation Q and terminal Lterm. Prove its actual absorbed transition P has (P^J(s0))(terminal states)=1 and its recursive outputs satisfy R_(J+m)(s0)=R_J(s0) for every m. Retain the explicit existing logarithmic upper bound on J. Derive pathwise termination for all observations and transport it to actual kernel laws; never assume stopping or a common deterministic eta schedule.
